stem: 在金融犯罪调查中，使用开源工具的主要优势有哪些？(选择两项.)

options.A: 数据收集与分析的部分自动化
options.B: 以经济高效的方式获取广泛的数据资源
options.C: 对选定交易和数据源进行实时监控
options.D: 具备在最少人工监督的情况下开展调查的能力
options.E: 更强的跨多个数据集识别关联的能力

stem_en: What are the primary advantages of using open-source tools in financial crime investigations? (Choose two.)

options_en.A: Partial automation of data collection and analysis.
options_en.B: Cost-effective access to a wide range of data.
options_en.C: Real-time monitoring of selected transactions and data sources.
options_en.D: Ability to conduct investigations with minimal human oversight.
options_en.E: Enhanced ability to identify connections across various datasets.
